subject: Workplace Skills
title: When to Stay Quiet
description: A short lesson to help you apply When to Stay Quiet.

hook.text: A VP vented frustration to a junior. The junior repeated it. By noon, three departments heard a rumor.

buildup.text: Information is currency at work. Sharing the wrong piece at the wrong time creates political fallout.

discovery.text: Before sharing anything sensitive, ask: was this told to me in confidence? Could repeating it harm someone?

twist.text: People test your discretion with small secrets before trusting you with big ones. Passing the test matters.

climax.text: Being known as discreet is one of the most valuable political assets. It earns trust from every level.

punchline.text: Guard secrets. Discretion is rare and powerful.

quiz.question: Why is discretion a powerful political asset at work?
options: It makes you mysterious and interesting
People trust you with important information when you prove discreet
Quiet people are promoted faster statistically
